meta.title: Counter offer while bidding is live on one of the two lines; the vendor accepts
gaps: Start from a live RFQ with two lines where Vendor A quoted 100 and 50.
Verify that only line 1 is countered while line 2 remains at its original quote of 50.
Verify the two-line Master QCS totals using both the countered and untouched line.

plan.title: Counter offer acceptance on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor's existing bid.
Counter the vendor's available bid at 90 while bidding is live.
Assert that the buyer's grid marks the vendor's bid with a counter offer.
Switch to the vendor portal and accept the pending counter offer as the bidding vendor.
Assert on the buyer side that the vendor's counter offer is marked accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the accepted current price.
Assert that the accepted countered price is now the vendor's RFQ rate.
Assert that the available line's amount and total follow the current rate and quantity.
